1 نَقَطَ الكِتَابَ , (S, Msb,) or الحَرْفَ, (K,) aor.
نَقُطَ , inf. n. نَقْطٌ, (S, Msb,) He pointed, or dotted. [the book, or writing, or] the letter, or word, with the diacritical points or point; and with the syllabical points or point, by which are shown the pronunciation and division of syllables and the desinential syntax; syn. أَعْجَمَهُ; as also ↓ نقّطهُ : (K:) and المصَاحِفَ ↓ نقّط , inf. n. تَنْقِيطٌ, [he so pointed the copies of the Kur-án.] (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
